title: 第12章 修罗杀道
slug: 修罗武帝全本免费-修罗武帝最新章节列表
content_zh:
虚空上方，神雷开始炸裂，化作无数道七彩雷光电弧。
只不过，七彩雷光之中，以黑色最为惹眼。
这些，姜辰并未留意，但这片虚空之中的一切，他却全部的都知道。
巨浪，冲击着那黑色的巨山，巨山剧烈的颤抖了起来。
随后，巨山山下，出现了一条小路，小路蜿蜒，只有十余米长。
小路的深处，一片茫茫紫雾，什么都看不清。
但这小路呈现出来的时候，姜辰也忽然明白了那四个古老文字的奥义——不是《天河剑诀》，而是《修罗杀道》。
而且，这《修罗杀道》显化出的信息，竟是隐约，有些与天空之中的雷霆气息相似。
“这是什么功法？竟是这么高等级？”
姜辰苏醒了刹那，随即心中骇然。
这种疑惑，第一次，这个魂海空间没有给予解释，姜辰没有得到对应的感悟，没有能如之前那样豁然明白答案。
姜辰并不遗憾，他抬头看向那黑山。
黑山，恍若一尊恶魔矗立在那里，立于海面上，任由海水咆哮而岿然不动。
山上，此时渐渐的被紫雾遮盖，显得异常的神秘。
黑山下方，那一条小路，逐渐清晰，但是那条路，姜辰一眼看过去，只觉得其有些神秘、凶险。但他心中想着踏入其中的时候，立刻就有一种极致的大恐怖的感觉生出！
姜辰心中骇然，他绝没有想到，《天河剑诀》，竟是忽然成为这样的存在。
那么，那个曾经的姜辰的真实身世又是什么？来自于何地？
很显然，这个问题，也是这个魂海空间无法给予答案的。
姜辰有些怔然出神。
但很快，他再次平静。

之前的一番思考，姜辰对《天河剑诀》，也有了更深的理解。
《天河剑诀》表面上有六重。但是《天河剑诀》的六重，其实只有一重。
结合黑山的情况，姜辰需要进入那小路之中修炼，才可以将《天河剑诀》的六重剑道合一，《修罗杀道》，具体有多么高深莫测，这一点，便是看这个无所不能的魂海空间里的那座巨山的情况，便可见一斑。
但姜辰并不失望，反而对《修罗杀道》，充满了期待。
或许，唯一可惜的，是他暂时无法进入那小路之中，去看看那一座山里，到底有什么秘密。
尽管很多答案在这里也找不到，但姜辰本能的相信，修罗黑山之中，一定有着关于他这个躯体的身世的原因。
姜辰深吸一口气，在虚空盘坐了下来，然后开始参悟《天河剑诀》的六重修炼心法，以及对应的天河剑道。
对剑道的领悟，姜辰本已经很深刻，如今再次领悟，姜辰立刻体会到了一种杀戮的意志。
这，便是剑意。
在外界很难领悟的东西，在这里，姜辰轻易的领悟了。
这或许有修罗黑山的影响，但是这空间本身的奇妙，也是显而易见的。
剑意领悟之后，姜辰对于剑道的把握，便更加深邃了。
六重天河剑诀，也在这样的领悟之中，近乎圆满。
随后，姜辰开始参悟灵魂修炼之法，这是《天河剑诀》里的附卷信息。
这一次参悟，黑山之中的紫气，竟是忽然如一道光，直接的逼射而来。
随后，姜辰恍若看到一个人影忽然出现在了他的脑海深处。
那个人影，忽然以指头点向他自身的眉心，他的眉心之中，立刻射出一道紫光，紫光直接烙印到了姜辰的记忆里。
《修罗炼魂诀》！
那一刻，姜辰豁然明白，恍若顿悟一般，领悟了《修罗炼魂诀》的修炼之法。
之前那个姜辰的灵魂修炼之法，正是《修罗炼魂诀》，只不过，那个姜辰，也仅仅只是学会了一点点的皮毛而已。

而这一次姜辰自己领悟，却是直接领悟了核心的《修罗炼魂诀》的修炼之法。
修炼之法，姜辰如今已经入门了。
但是想要修炼得高深的话，那种难度，就不是一般的大了。
因为这种修炼之法，是需要在黑山之中修炼的。
如今姜辰连黑山都进不去，更何谈修炼？
姜辰反复领悟，也只是多了一些心得体会，而没有其余的收获。
不过，这般领悟修炼，他在外界也吸纳到了大量的天地元气，境界距离真元境，已经十分逼近了。
这个时候，姜辰便也没有再对《修罗杀道》和《修罗炼魂诀》领悟了。

content_en:
Above the void, the divine thunder began to explode, turning into countless colorful lightning arcs.
However, among the seven colors of lightning, black is the most eye-catching.
Jiang Chen didn't pay attention to these, but he knew everything in the void.
The huge waves hit the huge black mountain, and the huge mountain trembled violently.
Then, at the foot of the giant mountain, a small path appeared. The path was winding and only more than ten meters long.
Deep in the path, there was a vast purple mist, and nothing could be seen clearly.
But when the path appeared, Jiang Chen suddenly understood the meaning of those four ancient words - not "Tianhe Sword Art", but "Asura Killing Way".
Moreover, the information manifested by the "Asura Killing Way" was actually vague, somewhat similar to the thunderous aura in the sky.
"What kind of skill is this? Is it such a high level?"
Jiang Chen woke up for a moment, and then felt horrified.
This kind of doubt, for the first time, was not explained in this soul sea space. Jiang Chen did not get the corresponding insights and could not suddenly understand the answer as before.
Jiang Chen was not sorry. He raised his head and looked at the black mountain.
Black Mountain seems like a devil standing there, standing on the sea, letting the sea roar and remain motionless.
The mountain was gradually covered by purple mist, looking extremely mysterious.
Under the Black Mountain, the path gradually became clearer, but when Jiang Chen took a quick look at that path, he felt that it was somewhat mysterious and dangerous. But he thought that when he stepped into it, he immediately felt an extremely terrifying feeling!
Jiang Chen was shocked in his heart. He never expected that "Tianhe Sword Art" would suddenly become such an existence.
So, what is the true life experience of the former Jiang Chen? Where do you come from?
Obviously, this question cannot be answered by this soul sea space.
Jiang Chen was a little stunned.
But soon he was calm again.
After thinking about it before, Jiang Chen also gained a deeper understanding of "Tianhe Sword Art".
"Tianhe Sword Art" has six levels on the surface. But among the six levels of "Tianhe Sword Art", there is actually only one level.
Considering the situation in Black Mountain, Jiang Chen needs to enter the path to practice before he can combine the six sword ways of "Tianhe Sword Technique" into one. The specific "Shura Killing Way" is unpredictable. This can be seen by looking at the situation of the huge mountain in the omnipotent soul sea space.
But Jiang Chen was not disappointed. Instead, he was full of expectations for "Asura Killing Way".
Perhaps the only pity was that he could not enter the path for the time being to see what secrets there were in that mountain.
Although many answers cannot be found here, Jiang Chen instinctively believes that there must be a reason for his body's life experience in Shura Black Mountain.
Jiang Chen took a deep breath, sat down cross-legged in the void, and then began to comprehend the six-level cultivation method of "Tianhe Sword Art" and the corresponding Tianhe Sword Dao.
Jiang Chen already had a profound understanding of the way of swordsmanship. Now that he understood it again, Jiang Chen immediately felt a will to kill.
This is the sword's intention.
Things that are difficult to comprehend in the outside world, Jiang Chen easily comprehended here.
This may have the influence of Shura Black Mountain, but the wonder of this space itself is also obvious.
After comprehending the meaning of the sword, Jiang Chen's grasp of the sword became even deeper.
The Sixth Level Tianhe Sword Technique was also comprehended in this way, and it was almost perfect.
Later, Jiang Chen began to understand the method of soul cultivation, which was included in the "Tianhe Sword Art".
This time, I realized that the purple energy in the black mountain suddenly shot towards me like a ray of light.
Then, Jiang Chen seemed to see a figure suddenly appear in the depths of his mind.
The figure suddenly pointed his finger at the center of his eyebrows, and a purple light immediately shot out from his eyebrows. The purple light was directly imprinted on Jiang Chen's memory.
"Shura Soul Refining Technique"!At that moment, Jiang Chen suddenly understood, as if he had an epiphany, he understood the cultivation method of "Shura Soul Refining Technique".
The previous Jiang Chen's soul cultivation method was the "Shura Soul Refining Technique", but that Jiang Chen only learned a little bit of it.
But this time Jiang Chen realized it himself, but he directly understood the core cultivation method of "Shura Soul Refining Technique".
Jiang Chen has now mastered the method of cultivation.
But if you want to practice deeply, the difficulty is not that great.
Because this kind of cultivation method needs to be practiced in the Black Mountain.
Now Jiang Chen can't even enter Black Mountain, let alone practice?
Jiang Chen repeatedly understood, but only gained some insights, but no other gains.
However, through such understanding and cultivation, he has also absorbed a large amount of heaven and earth energy from the outside world, and his realm is already very close to the true element state.
At this time, Jiang Chen no longer understood the "Asura Killing Way" and "Asura Soul Refining Technique".
